description: enables the default permissions. Updater is granted by least privilege and no further: allow-check for the manual 'Check for Updates' action, and allow-download-and-install for the explicit, admin-confirmed install path in the Application Updates card. `updater:default` is deliberately NOT granted -- it would hand the webview install-at-once and other permissions the Station update flow never calls, so the two permissions below are exactly the updater surface the signed-update flow needs. `process:allow-restart` is included because the update flow relaunches the app through tauri-plugin-process after a successful install (process:allow-exit is deliberately NOT granted -- Station exits only through the Windows installer). NOTE: this file is strict JSON and the Tauri capability parser rejects comments, so the rationale lives in this description.
